test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends, K, M, P, R, T, and Y, are sitting in a circle facing the center. R is sitting to the immediate left of M. K is second to the right of M. T is sitting exactly between M and K. P is not sitting next to K or M. Who is sitting opposite to P?
solution:
Given: Six friends, K, M, P, R, T, and Y, are sitting in a circle facing the center.

R is sitting to the immediate left of M.

K is second to the right of M.

P is not sitting next to K or M.

T is sitting exactly between M and K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04670461e88f4de09b99dd98817090556cdecb6be9814f16a66617e0f9a2ed1b.png] 

And Y sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23866fd4a0d64bc2cf48cfac80919338358206882674363961a9e847d5b1b5d9.png] 

T is sitting opposite to P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
